_comment: Actuarial selections log. Each entry records a departure from the mechanical method and why. A selection applies to any valuation on or after the month it references, so hindsight re-runs use only what was knowable at each close.

exclude_paid_months.2026-06: Claims operations reported a processing slowdown in June 2026 (claims system migration). The paid-month diagnostic shows June payments at 87% of expected. Link ratios on this diagonal understate development and are excluded from the averages.
exclude_paid_months.2026-07: Catch-up of the June backlog: July payments ran 128% of expected. Link ratios on this diagonal overstate development and are excluded from the averages.

restate_paid_months.2026-06: At the June 2026 close, paid-to-date on every open month is short by the delayed payments. Claims operations' pended-inventory report gives the excess pended dollars by category. Paid is grossed up by paid / (paid + excess pended) before completion factors are applied, so the backlog is reserved for rather than read as lower cost.
